pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: jbd2: if the journal is aborted then don't allow update of the log tail This updates the jbd2 superblock unnecessarily, and on an abort we shouldn't truncate the log. BUG=b:127525694 TEST=None Signed-off-by: Theodore Ts'o <tytso@mit.edu> Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org (cherry picked from commit 85e0c4e89c1b864e763c4e3bb15d0b6d501ad5d9) Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Change-Id: Ic33e238f4edb9f21953fa6e019f5ad76cef9deda Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1506022 Commit-Ready: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Tested-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Zubin Mithra <zsm@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: jbd2: fix use after free in kjournald2() Below is the synchronization issue between unmount and kjournald2 contexts, which results into use after free issue in kjournald2(). Fix this issue by using journal->j_state_lock to synchronize the wait_event() done in journal_kill_thread() and the wake_up() done in kjournald2(). TASK 1: umount cmd: |--jbd2_journal_destroy() { |--journal_kill_thread() { write_lock(&journal->j_state_lock); journal->j_flags |= JBD2_UNMOUNT; ... write_unlock(&journal->j_state_lock); wake_up(&journal->j_wait_commit); TASK 2 wakes up here: kjournald2() { ... checks JBD2_UNMOUNT flag and calls goto end-loop; ... end_loop: write_unlock(&journal->j_state_lock); journal->j_task = NULL; --> If this thread gets pre-empted here, then TASK 1 wait_event will exit even before this thread is completely done. wait_event(journal->j_wait_done_commit, journal->j_task == NULL); ... write_lock(&journal->j_state_lock); write_unlock(&journal->j_state_lock); } |--kfree(journal); } } wake_up(&journal->j_wait_done_commit); --> this step now results into use after free issue. } BUG=b:127525694 TEST=None Signed-off-by: Sahitya Tummala <stummala@codeaurora.org> Signed-off-by: Theodore Ts'o <tytso@mit.edu> (cherry picked from commit dbfcef6b0f4012c57bc0b6e0e660d5ed12a5eaed) Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Change-Id: I77a4d378f7c9233bbea55906aa65443ec32e844c Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1506023 Commit-Ready: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Tested-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Zubin Mithra <zsm@chromium.org>

BACKPORT: jbd2: don't mark block as modified if the handle is out of credits commit e09463f220ca9a1a1ecfda84fcda658f99a1f12a upstream. Do not set the b_modified flag in block's journal head should not until after we're sure that jbd2_journal_dirty_metadat() will not abort with an error due to there not being enough space reserved in the jbd2 handle. Otherwise, future attempts to modify the buffer may lead a large number of spurious errors and warnings. This addresses CVE-2018-10883. https://bugzilla.kernel.org/show_bug.cgi?id=200071 BUG=b:127525694 TEST=None Signed-off-by: Theodore Ts'o <tytso@mit.edu> [bwh: Backported to 3.16: Drop the added logging statement, as it's on a code path that doesn't exist here] Signed-off-by: Ben Hutchings <ben@decadent.org.uk> Signed-off-by: Greg Hackmann <ghackmann@google.com> Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org> (cherry picked from commit 524100251d15d4dc491671b84854017327ff2dba linux-3.18.y) Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Change-Id: I748095dbbfec3ff7b73a049fccce64d7e0cf663f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1506024 Commit-Ready: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Tested-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Zubin Mithra <zsm@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: jbd2: fix use after free in jbd2_log_do_checkpoint() The code cleaning transaction's lists of checkpoint buffers has a bug where it increases bh refcount only after releasing journal->j_list_lock. Thus the following race is possible: CPU0 CPU1 jbd2_log_do_checkpoint() jbd2_journal_try_to_free_buffers() __journal_try_to_free_buffer(bh) ... while (transaction->t_checkpoint_io_list) ... if (buffer_locked(bh)) { <-- IO completes now, buffer gets unlocked --> spin_unlock(&journal->j_list_lock); spin_lock(&journal->j_list_lock); __jbd2_journal_remove_checkpoint(jh); spin_unlock(&journal->j_list_lock); try_to_free_buffers(page); get_bh(bh) <-- accesses freed bh Fix the problem by grabbing bh reference before unlocking journal->j_list_lock. BUG=b:127525694 TEST=None Fixes: dc6e8d669cf5 ("jbd2: don't call get_bh() before calling __jbd2_journal_remove_checkpoint()") Fixes: be1158cc615f ("jbd2: fold __process_buffer() into jbd2_log_do_checkpoint()") Change-Id: I1a0c5c124ef6d65e501b0e217e2b042283ef7aa1 Reported-by: syzbot+7f4a27091759e2fe7453@syzkaller.appspotmail.com CC: stable@vger.kernel.org Reviewed-by: Lukas Czerner <lczerner@redhat.com> Signed-off-by: Jan Kara <jack@suse.cz> Signed-off-by: Theodore Ts'o <tytso@mit.edu> (cherry picked from commit ccd3c4373eacb044eb3832966299d13d2631f66f) Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1506025 Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Zubin Mithra <zsm@chromium.org>

chipset-{kbl,rk3399}: statically link libcamera_jpeg into the camera HALs Build and link libcamera_jpeg as static library so that we can statically link all libraries that use Mojo.
